note.question: How does the use of echelon base-stock policies for our system (even though they are known to be suboptimal) and propose algorithms for finding base-stock levels that are easy to understand and implement?
note.overview: This paper studies a periodically reviewed multiechelon serial inventory system with a capacity constraint on the order quantity at each stage. The cost criterion we use to evaluate inventory policies for this system is the sum of the expected long-run average holding and shortage costs. It is well known that for this problem, characterizing the structure of the optimal policy and computing it are very difficult.
